title: Rust: cross-validate epoch_rollover.json vectors
description: test/vectors/epoch_rollover.json is validated only by python/tests/test_vectors.py. rust/lichen-link/src/replay.rs and seqnum.rs implement the same epoch semantics ((epoch<<16)|seqnum unsigned ordering, increment on wrap, reject 255->0 rollover) but no Rust test consumes the vector file, unlike replay_window.json which is cross-validated in rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs (gated behind --features schnorr,std). Add a shared_vectors test that replays the epoch_rollover.json sender_sequence/receiver_state vectors through the Rust implementation so both implementations prove identical accept/reject decisions per project rule 'all implementations MUST produce identical output for test vectors'.
close_reason: Added test_epoch_rollover_vectors to rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs (gated behind --features schnorr,std like its replay_window sibling). Drives the real ReplayProtector through all epoch_rollover.json vector shapes: sender_sequence accept flags + counter math, receiver_state/received decisions (duplicate_in_window precondition reconstructed via public API and cross-checked against the recorded window bitmap bits), tuple ordering with canonical hex, unsigned comparisons, cold-boot init range, and post-terminal-counter epoch-wrap rejection. Mutation check performed: flipping one expected decision makes the test fail; vector file restored. Gates: cargo fmt clean, clippy -D-free (0 warnings), lichen-link full suite 104+1+1+6+2 passed, python test_vectors.py 645 passed.
